Which autoimmune diseases improve when B cells or plasma cells are targeted,
and what can identify the patients most likely to benefit? This project compares
disease mechanisms with clinical intervention evidence, including response and
nonresponse to rituximab.

## Documents

- [Working specification](specification.qmd). Scope, evidence standards and
  the questions that remain to be answered.
- [Evidence review and disease ranking](evidence-review.qmd). The initial
  synthesis, target comparison and approach to patient stratification.
- [References](references.qmd). Recommended reviews first, followed by the
  studies supporting the synthesis and their verification status.

The related [imm-biopsy project](../imm-biopsy/index.qmd) addresses whether blood
and biopsy measurements represent B cells in other tissues.
